- His father died while he was on TUF, which was the season where the fights were live, he stayed on the show and ultimately won it

- During my time covering him, he was exceptional to deal with. Always gave honest interviews and was generous with his time

- Stood up for his mother when she was insulted at a press conference

- As a fighter, he was entertaining, opportunistic and creative 

Being a champion is a rare distinction, but it’s not the only marker of a good influence. Having great character and values are also the markers of someone to look up.
